policy: Compare what each passage does and how its participants relate, not shared topics or names. Read the source; generated questions are only hints. For paragraph windows judge the center, not its neighbors. Each paper in a group must support the role; read its accepted members together and require each to contribute.
has_match_question: Does any eligible candidate perform the same source-supported role as the focus?
gate_example: Focus describes a comparison tool. Candidates report its evaluation results or its recruitment procedure. Neither describes the capability: no match.
ranking_question: Which eligible candidate best preserves the focus's role and relevant relationships?
rank_example: Focus explains how readers compare two excerpts. A measures speed using the same tool; B describes another tool's side-by-side comparison. Choose B: it explains the capability.
